newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean banks scrap plan to sell Woosung to Hanil.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean banks scrap plan to sell Woosung to Hanil.

text.p: Creditor banks of insolvent Woosung Construction Co scrapped a plan to sell the company to Hanil Group, an official at Korea First Bank, a main creditor, said on Wednesday.
"Woosung's five largest creditors will set up a committee to find another buyer," said the official, who asked not to be identified.
Hanil refused to respect conditions set out by an earlier agreement and demanded that Woosung remain under court receivership even after its takeover.

Under the agreement, creditors were to provide loans totalling 275.7 billion won to Hanil while the group had to raise 274.6 billion won by selling off its real estate. Woosung defaulted on promissory notes worth 16.9 billion won in January 1996 and the creditors decided to sell it off to Hanil four months later.
Woosung was South Korea's third largest home builder and the 18th largest construction company.
